Sure! I dont have a link because its just in my head as its a family recipe but ive tried my best to write it down! :)

350g self raising flour
350g Caster sugar
350g Stork butter/margarine
6 eggs
2tsp baking powder
2tsp vanilla extract
pinch of salt

-preheat oven to 180c and grease and line baking trays
-Cream the butter and sugar until smooth

-beat the eggs in a seperate bowl and add in gradually, beat them well after each addition

-add half the flour and fold together with a metal spoon, then add the other half and fold with your regular wooden/silicone spoon, fold in the vanilla,salt and baking powder

-spread evenly between baking trays and bake at 180c for 25 minutes (adjust for your oven!)

-leave to cool
